newsitem.title: CHINA: China Everbright Bank becomes shareholding bank.
newsitem.headline: China Everbright Bank becomes shareholding bank.

text.p: China's Everbright Bank has completed its transformation to a joint stock bank, the first in China, with total shares worth 2.8 billion yuan ($337 million), said a shareholders' report seen on Tuesday.
Everbright Bank, wholly owned by China Everbright (Group) Corp, holds 51 percent of total shares while the other 131 shareholders held 49 percent, it said.

The 131 other shareholders included large and medium-sized state enterprises and the Asian Development Bank, and had purchased their total of 1.37 billion shares at 1.8 yuan per share, 0.8 yuan higher than the face value of each share, it said.
China's Everbright Bank recorded profits of 891 million yuan in 1996 and its assets totalled 52.9 billion yuan at the end of last year, an earlier report said.

The Asian Development Bank had taken a 3.3 percent share in the bank with an investment of about $20 million, the first time China has allowed foreign funds to take a share in a domestic financial institution.
